name: Judgment
overview: Scripture reveals that divine judgment is an inevitable and just reality where God evaluates every person according to their deeds and opportunities, as seen in Genesis 4:7 and Job 31:13-15. The wicked are reserved for a day of wrath and destruction (Job 21:30), while God’s perfect justice encompasses even secret sins (Job 14:17) and holds all accountable. This solemn truth calls believers to live righteously, trusting in Christ's righteousness while recognizing that all will ultimately stand before God’s judgment.
